# Local dependency repository

This directory contains the M152 `webrtc-java` build used by the NetherNet LAN transport.
The upstream M138 native build rejects the SDP generated by current iOS Bedrock clients, so the
working M152 artifacts are kept here to make this fork reproducible without a machine-local
Maven repository.

The artifacts come from the successful cross-platform CI run for
[`Kas-tle/webrtc-java` PR #4](https://github.com/Kas-tle/webrtc-java/pull/4), commit
`04a3d55ca22254a3d508173ac7fa250f44ff2151`, workflow run `31000968829` in
`SendableMetatype/webrtc-java`. The Java classes from that run are byte-for-byte identical across
platforms. Native classifiers included by this fork are:

- Linux x86-64: CI artifact SHA-256
  `b38f10af8ea3a093e3df104b3167466bee3440b22cb36bf163a25d293b7c6966` after Loom metadata was added.
- macOS arm64: original CI artifact SHA-256
  `e28b2f2f2e5ecef60dcfe576f67240c1da6b0ab6b4a121894799c52ab41afc97`.

When supporting another operating system or architecture, add the matching classifier from the
same CI commit, include it in `configureBedrockDependencies`, and extend
`WebRtcNativeLibraryTest`. Do not mix native libraries from M138 or a different JNI commit with
the M152 Java classes.
